ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>90%) across the central surface with low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (<10%) concentrated at the periphery and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white central mass; low-intensity dark pigmentation forms a thin, irregular border along the trailing edge and distal tips; a singular dark focal point is located at the inferior central meridian.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 55-degree angle and significant vertical pixel depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the length of the trailing edge, transitioning into high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly linear to slightly convex curve fitted from the median notch to the outer lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark, high-contrast pixel clusters concentrated at the left and right distal tips; scattered smaller dark clusters along the superior trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single vertical dark linear disruption located near the lower central axis of the visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced textured massing and protuberances at both the left and right distal lobe tips, indicating significant barnacle colonization sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated dark spot/pigmentation mark situated in the lower third of the white high-intensity field near the central fluke divide.
